Little game for you.

Watch the clock with a sweeping second hand.

Start the count on 1, when the second hand passes the line.

Keep doing that for like ten seconds.

Now, look away from the clock and keep counting.

Look back at the clock in 10 seconds.

How accurate were you?

Then, instead of counting one beat per second, count 2 per second and four per second.

This will not help you with specific time signatures, but it will help you train your internal clock.
